strings: r_c continues {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} test, but it's clear that m_c's hearing isn't what it used to be, likely as a result of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ear injury.
r_c informs m_c that though {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ear has healed from its tear, there was still permanent damage done. m_c will struggle to hear out of that ear for the rest of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life.
m_c realizes that it's not that the camp has been more peaceful lately. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} just can't hear as much as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} used to.
